theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 29 群

items.colloc: for public display 供公開展示 | public display of affection 公眾放閃
items.distinct: exhibition 展覽會 | demonstration 示範說明
ex: The artwork is now on public display at the lobby.
這件藝術品目前在大廳公開展示。
These documents are not for public display.
這些文件不適合對外公開展示。
He made a public display of his frustration.
他公開表現出了他的挫折感。

items.colloc: during a public holiday 在國定假日期間 | observe a public holiday 慶祝國定假日
items.distinct: vacation 個人假期 | day off 休假日
ex: The office will be closed on the public holiday.
辦公室將在國定假日當天關閉。
We usually travel abroad during the public holiday.
我們通常在國定假日期間出國旅遊。
Staff are entitled to pay for the public holiday.
員工有權領取國定假日的薪資。

items.colloc: pull up to the curb 靠邊停車 | pull up a chair 拉張椅子過來
items.distinct: stop 停止 | pull over 路邊停車
ex: Please pull up a chair and join the meeting.
請拉張椅子過來加入會議。
The delivery truck pulled up in front of the store.
貨車停在商店門口。
Management pulled him up for his frequent tardiness.
管理層因他頻繁遲到而糾正了他的行為。

items.colloc: gain market share 擴大市占率 | lose market share 失去市占率
items.distinct: market segment 市場區隔 | competitive advantage 競爭優勢
ex: The company aims to increase its market share by 5%.
公司目標是將市占率提升百分之五。
We are losing market share to new competitors.
我們正因新對手而流失市占率。
The firm holds the largest market share in the industry.
該公司擁有業界最大的市場佔有率。

items.colloc: be engaged in business 從事商業 | be engaged in research 投入研究
items.distinct: engage 訂婚；吸引 | busy with 忙於
ex: Our company is engaged in international trade and logistics.
我們公司從事國際貿易與物流業務。
The team is currently engaged in a deep market analysis.
團隊目前正忙於進行深入的市場分析。
We are engaged in developing new software for retailers.
我們致力於為零售商開發新的軟體。

items.colloc: reach a record high 達到歷史新高 | hit a record high 創下最高紀錄
items.distinct: peak 頂峰 | all-time high 史上最高
ex: Inflation has reached a record high this quarter.
通貨膨脹在本季達到了歷史新高。
Our sales figures hit a record high in June.
我們的銷售額在六月創下歷史新高。
The stock price climbed to a record high today.
股價今日攀升至歷史新高。

items.colloc: write a reference letter 寫推薦信 | request a reference letter 要求推薦信
items.distinct: resume 履歷表 | recommendation 推薦
ex: She asked her former boss for a reference letter.
她向以前的老闆要求寫一封推薦信。
A strong reference letter can help you get hired.
強而有力的推薦信能幫你被錄取。
Please submit a reference letter with your application.
請在申請時附上一封推薦信。

items.colloc: postpone the release date 延後發布日期 | announce the release date 宣布上市日期
items.distinct: launch date 產品發表日 | deadline 截止日期
ex: The official release date of the game is Friday.
這款遊戲的正式發布日期是星期五。
We need to confirm the product release date soon.
我們需要盡快確認產品上市日期。
The release date was moved up to next week.
發布日期被提前到下週。

items.colloc: respond to an email 回覆郵件 | respond to a complaint 回應客訴
items.distinct: reply to 回覆 | react to 對...做出反應
ex: You should respond to his inquiry as soon as possible.
你應該盡快回應他的詢問。
The company responded to the crisis very quickly.
公司對這場危機的回應非常迅速。
Please respond to the invitation by tomorrow morning.
請在明天早上前回應這份邀請。

items.colloc: contribute to a retirement plan 存入退休金 | discuss a retirement plan 討論退休方案
items.distinct: pension 年金 | 401(k) 美國退休儲蓄計畫
ex: The company offers an excellent retirement plan.
公司提供了一項優渥的退休金方案。
I need to start contributing to my retirement plan.
我需要開始為我的退休計畫存錢。
She is reviewing her long-term retirement plan.
她正在檢視她長期的退休計畫。

items.colloc: promptly return a phone call 即時回電 | expect to return a phone call 等待回電
items.distinct: make a call 打電話 | call back 回撥
ex: I will return your phone call after the meeting.
會議結束後我會回覆你的電話。
He failed to return the phone call yesterday.
他昨天沒能回覆那通電話。
Make sure to return the phone call to the client.
務必記得回電給客戶。

items.colloc: cope with rising costs 應對成本上漲 | impact of rising costs 成本上升的影響
items.distinct: inflation 通貨膨脹 | price hike 價格猛漲
ex: We are struggling with the rising costs of raw materials.
我們正為了原物料成本上升而苦惱。
The rising costs are affecting our profit margins.
成本上升正影響著我們的利潤空間。
Management is looking for ways to cut rising costs.
管理層正在尋找削減成本上升的方法。

items.zh: 推出（新產品）；實施（新計畫）
items.colloc: roll out a new strategy 實施新策略 | roll out a product 推出新產品
items.distinct: launch 發表 | introduce 引進
ex: The company will roll out the new software next month.
公司將在下個月推出這款新軟體。
They are ready to roll out the marketing campaign.
他們準備好執行這項行銷活動了。
The new policy will be rolled out gradually.
這項新政策將會逐步實施。

items.colloc: book a round trip 預訂來回票 | round trip ticket 來回機票
items.distinct: one-way 單程 | transit 過境
ex: I bought a round trip ticket for the business trip.
我買了這次出差的來回機票。
The round trip takes about four hours in total.
整趟來回行程總共大約四小時。
We offer a discount on all round trip fares.
我們為所有往返票價提供折扣。

items.zh: 發起活動；執行廣告行銷
items.colloc: run a marketing campaign 進行行銷活動 | run a campaign for the project 為專案執行活動
items.distinct: launch a campaign 發起運動 | execute a plan 執行計畫
ex: They are running a campaign to promote the new model.
他們正在進行一項活動來推廣新機型。
We decided to run a campaign on social media.
我們決定在社群媒體上執行行銷活動。
The non-profit is running a campaign for donations.
該非營利組織正在發起一項捐款活動。

items.colloc: run an article in the paper 在報紙刊登文章 | run an article online 在線上發表文章
items.distinct: publish 出版 | print 印刷
ex: The magazine will run an article about our success.
這本雜誌將會刊登一篇關於我們成功的文章。
Did you see the article they ran in the news?
你有看到他們在新聞中報導的那篇文章嗎？
The editor decided to run an article on climate change.
編輯決定刊登一篇關於氣候變遷的文章。

items.colloc: be committed to excellence 致力於卓越 | be committed to service 致力於服務
items.distinct: devote to 奉獻於 | dedicated to 專注於
ex: We are committed to providing the best customer support.
我們致力於提供最佳的客戶支援服務。
The firm is committed to reducing its carbon footprint.
該公司致力於減少其碳足跡。
Our employees are committed to achieving annual sales goals.
我們的員工皆承諾要達成年度銷售目標。

items.colloc: run late for a meeting 會議遲到 | run late with a report 報告進度延誤
items.distinct: behind schedule 進度落後 | delayed 延遲
ex: I am running late for the morning conference call.
我早上那場電話會議要遲到了。
The train is running late due to bad weather.
因為天氣惡劣，火車誤點了。
We are running late with the quarterly report submission.
我們繳交季報的進度有些延誤。

items.colloc: run out of stock 庫存不足 | run out of time 時間用盡
items.distinct: consume 消耗 | deplete 用光
ex: We have run out of printer paper in the office.
辦公室的印表機紙張用完了。
We are running out of time to finish the task.
我們快沒時間完成這項任務了。
The company ran out of budget for the project.
公司為該專案準備的預算已經耗盡。

items.colloc: the first runner up 第一亞軍 | announce the runner up 宣布亞軍
items.distinct: winner 冠軍 | finalist 決賽入圍者
ex: The runner up received a certificate of achievement.
亞軍獲頒了一張成就證書。
We were the runner up in the annual design competition.
我們在年度設計競賽中獲得亞軍。
The runner up will be invited to the final ceremony.
亞軍將會受邀參加最後的頒獎典禮。
